property_summary: For every inputs, the correct contract C always calls its callee using the selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with arguments (from,to,v) so a callee that records decoded arguments will always observe the uint256 argument equal to v; the mutant encodes the arguments in the wrong order (v,from,to) so for some fuzzed inputs the recorded decoded uint256 will not equal v and thus the property is violated.
change_summary: Replace the external call with a direct ABI-encoded call that uses wrong argument order (v before _tos[i]) causing the callee to likely revert, changing revert behavior.
